lines.text: Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, lived there, and went out and built Penuel.
Jeroboam feared that if the people sacrificed in Jerusalem, their hearts would return to Rehoboam, and they would kill him.
After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves and set one up in Bethel and the other in Hebron.
Jeroboam built shrines on the high places and appointed priests from every class of people who were not Levites.
Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth day of the ninth month and offered sacrifices on the altar in Bethel.
